jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Project Role :** Product Owner  
**Project Role Description :** Drives the vision for the product by being the voice of the customer, following a human-centered design approach. Shapes and manages the product roadmap and product backlog and ensures the product team consistently deliver on the clients needs and wants. Validates and tests ideas through recurrent feedback loops to ensure knowledge discovery informs timely direction changes.
  
**Must have skills :** Software Product Management  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **7.5** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of our Data Ingestion and Customer Onboarding experiences. This role is responsible for defining how customer data is collected, transformed, validated, and activated across our products, ensuring customers achieve value quickly and efficiently.  
  
The successful candidate will develop a deep understanding of our products, platform strategy, customer needs, and company objectives to drive a cohesive vision for onboarding and data ingestion capabilities. They will work cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partner teams to deliver scalable solutions that improve customer adoption and operational efficiency.
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
Product Strategy & Vision  
  
Define and own the product vision and strategy for data ingestion, onboarding experiences.  
Develop a roadmap aligned with company objectives, customer needs, and platform priorities.  
Evaluate trade-offs, dependencies, technical constraints, and alternative approaches to maximize business value.  
Establish short-term and long-term priorities while balancing customer commitments, strategic investments, and technical debt.  
Partner with leadership to ensure alignment across product portfolios and business units.  
  
Customer Onboarding & User Journey Ownership  
  
Own the end-to-end onboarding experience, from customer setup through successful product adoption.  
Identify friction points in onboarding workflows and drive improvements that reduce implementation effort and time-to-value.  
Understand customer data requirements, integration patterns, and operational workflows.  
Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Support teams to continuously improve customer onboarding outcomes.  
Define onboarding metrics and success criteria to measure adoption, activation, and customer health.  
  
Product Execution  
  
Translate business requirements into detailed product requirements, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria.  
Manage and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer impact, technical dependencies, and strategic priorities.  
Work closely with Engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.  
Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, and feature validation.  
Ensure delivered capabilities meet user needs and align with product strategy.  
Data Ingestion & Platform Capabilities  
  
Define capabilities for data ingestion, mapping, validation, transformation, monitoring, and governance.  
Understand modern integration technologies, APIs, connectors, ETL/ELT processes, and SaaS application integrations.  
Drive solutions that enable efficient onboarding of customer data from multiple source systems.  
Partner with platform teams to establish scalable and reusable ingestion services and experiences.  
Define approaches for handling data quality, exceptions, observability, and onboarding automation.  
  
Stakeholder Management  
  
Collaborate with Product Managers across the portfolio to ensure consistency and alignment across products.  
Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and engineering teams.  
Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to gather feedback and drive alignment.  
Communicate priorities, roadmap decisions, and product direction effectively at all levels of the organization.  
  
Customer Engagement & Product Evangelism  
  
Conduct customer interviews and gather insights to validate product direction.  
Demonstrate product capabilities to customers, prospects, partners, and internal stakeholders.  
Support customer workshops, onboarding reviews, and strategic discussions.  
Present roadmap updates and product outcomes to leadership and cross-functional teams.
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
5+ years of Product Management experience in a SaaS, enterprise software, platform, or data-centric environment.  
Strong understanding of software development processes and Agile methodologies.  
Experience building and managing product roadmaps.  
Experience writing detailed requirements, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria.  
Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar product management tools.  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex trade-offs.  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  
Ability to work effectively across Engineering, Design, Operations, Customer Success, and Product organizations.
  
Additional Information:
  
Experience with data onboarding, data integration, data management, APIs.  
Experience designing customer onboarding and implementation experiences.  
Familiarity with enterprise software ecosystems such as ERP, CRM, eCommerce, procurement, or finance platforms.  
Understanding of customer journey mapping and user experience principles.  
Experience with cloud-based platforms and modern SaaS architectures.  
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and observability concepts.  
Experience supporting customer demonstrations, workshops, and enterprise implementations.

**Technical & Creative Content Writer - B2B**

**Location:** Hyderabad, Onsite  
**Experience:** 2 to 6 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About The Smarketers**

The Smarketers is a B2B marketing agency that works with technology companies to help them build their brand, generate demand, and grow their business.

We work with clients across SaaS, IT Services, Manufacturing, Industrial Automation, Telecom, Healthcare, ERP, FinTech, and other technology-driven B2B industries.

Content is one of the key pillars of what we do. We create blogs, eBooks, whitepapers, case studies, website content, social media content, brochures, reports, video scripts, and other marketing and sales content.

**About the Role**

**Do you understand technology and have a flair for creative writing?Can you turn complex B2B technology and business topics into content that people want to read?**

If yes, that is what we are looking for.

As a **Technical & Creative Content Writer - B2B**, you will plan, research, create, and edit content for our B2B technology clients.

You will work across different industries and need to understand the client's business, products, technology, customers, industry, competitors, and positioning before creating content. You should be able to understand both the **technical and business side** of a product and turn complex topics into clear, engaging, and relevant content for B2B audiences.

You will create content for different stages of the B2B buyer journey, from building awareness and educating audiences to generating interest, supporting demand generation, and helping move prospects towards a buying decision.

The role also requires a good understanding of how B2B content is discovered and consumed through search engines, answer engines, and AI-powered search.

* Understand the client's business, products, services, technology, industry, customers, decision-makers, competitors, positioning, and tone of voice.

* Understand AEO and how content can be structured to answer questions clearly and effectively.
* Understand how B2B audiences are increasingly discovering information through AI-powered search and LLMs and apply relevant content practices.
* Review and improve existing content based on relevance, readability, search intent, and audience engagement.
* Edit, proofread, fact-check, and quality check content before delivery.
* Work with subject matter experts, clients, Account Managers, SEO, Design, and other internal teams to develop the required content.
* Ensure content is original, well researched, factually accurate, and aligned with the client's business and marketing objectives.
* Use AI tools where appropriate to support research, brainstorming, information gathering, editing, and improving productivity and speed.
* Take ownership of content deliverables and ensure they are completed within agreed timelines.
* Stay updated on B2B industries, technology, content marketing, SEO, search trends, and new content formats.

**Requirements**

* 2 to 6 years of relevant experience in B2B content writing, technical writing, technology content, or a similar role.
* Strong writing skills with the ability to create both technical and creative B2B content.
* Ability to understand technology, business concepts, products, and services and explain them in simple, clear, and engaging language.
* Strong understanding of B2B audiences, decision-makers, buying journeys, and business challenges.
* Strong research skills and the ability to quickly understand new industries, technologies, products, and businesses.
* Good understanding of B2B content marketing and inbound marketing.
* Good understanding of SEO, search intent, keyword research, and content optimization.
* Working knowledge of AEO and awareness of AI-powered search and LLM-based content discovery.
* Ability to create content that is optimized for search without compromising creativity, readability, or the reader's experience.
* Excellent grammar, editing, proofreading, and communication skills.
* Ability to write in different styles, from technical and informative to creative, conversational, and thought leadership content.
* Good command of US and British English.
* Ability to manage multiple client projects and deadlines without compromising quality.
* Self-motivated, curious, and willing to learn new industries and technologies.

* Experience writing for SaaS, IT Services, Manufacturing, Industrial Automation, Telecom, Healthcare, ERP, FinTech, or similar B2B industries is preferred.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating technical, creative, B2B, or thought leadership content is preferred.

Write landing pages, one-pagers and product descriptions across STARK, Helix, VoxClash and our physical AI line.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Build the field software that helps maintain and update information about the network for Electric, Gas, Water or Telecommunications.
  
When work happens in the Field, whether its event driven, maintenance activities, or other planned work, We build the software those crews and Field Engineers use. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead continued improvements to the products at the center of that work: GridOS Field and its unified App and User Experience. One field app supporting many complex business flows and outcomes
  
This role owns how utility field workers capture critical information while performing work. Your decisions will shape how quickly and efficiently utilities capture and maintain data that is constantly changing in the Field.

**Job Description**
===================

Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for product and workflow inside GridOS Field. Your day to day will include:

* **Owning the roadmap.** Set direction for new workflows and enhancements to GridOS Field. Prioritize based on customer needs, technology changes, regulatory drivers, and business impact.
* **Working with customers.** Spend time with utility damage assessors, field supervisors, and control room staff. Validate real problems before writing a single requirement.
* **Working with your Peer Product Management teams who also manage the product lifecycle of GridOS Field**
* **Driving delivery.** Partner with engineering, design, and UX to ship high quality releases on a predictable cadence. Support the Lean operating rhythm.
* **Working with Requirements Management tools: These** tools help document and drive the roadmaps and priorities that help shape strategy, delivery and on-going improvements to GridOS Field
* **Connecting to the platform.** Make sure your products feel like one app with the rest of GridOS Field. Work with the UX PM and the other GridOS Field PMs to keep the experience unified.
* **Using AI.** Apply AI to speed up damage triage, image capture workflows, and data quality checks. Use AI tools in your own workflow to move faster.
* **Supporting sales and delivery.** Join customer calls, write positioning material, and help account teams win and deliver deals with Southern Company, PPL, and the accounts that follow them.
* **Guiding customers off legacy.** Help utilities move from FieldSmart, AEMS, and other legacy tools onto the modern GridOS Field platform.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Product management or other Management experience with complex enterprise software, ideally in utilities, energy, telecom, or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of utility field operations, outage restoration, or ADMS/DMS/OMS and other Field Maintenance Flows. If you have not lived it, you have shipped software to people who have.
* A track record of running more than one program at a time with a clear, data-driven approach.
* Comfort with AI tools in your own product workflow.
* Strong writing and communication. You can turn a messy customer conversation into a clear requirement, a crisp roadmap update, or a one-page memo.
* Commercial judgment. You can connect a product decision to a revenue, cost, or customer outcome.
* A Lean and Agile mindset. You adjust quickly when priorities shift, and you close things out.

**Education Requirements**
--------------------------

**For US candidates:** A Master's degree, or a High School Diploma/GED with at least six years of professional experience.

**For non-US candidates:** A Master's equivalent, or a High School Diploma with relevant professional experience.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

You will work on software that utilities depend on during their most challenging times to maintain infrastructure stability while experiencing exponential growth in demand. restoring service.

We offer:

* **Real impact.** Providing Value to Large Tier 1 and Tier2 Utility and Telco companies, with a clear runway to grow.
* **Modern stack.** Single-tenant SaaS on hyperscaler infrastructure, with AI built in through the Prism platform.
* **Direct customer contact.** You talk to the people using the product, not just the people buying it.
* **Growth.** GridOS Field is scaling. Strong PMs move up.

**Success in This Role**
------------------------

You will know you are succeeding when the Adoption rate of GridOS Field increasing and becomes a key part of both our existing customer base and prospects.

**Working Arrangement**
-----------------------

Permanent, fully remote. Occasional travel to customer sites and GE Vernova offices.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from everyone who meets the criteria and is interested in the future of the grid.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Associate Satisfaction
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every day, Amazon Customer Service associates help millions of customers around the world. Their ability to deliver exceptional customer experiences depends on feeling supported, empowered, and equipped to succeed.  
  
We are building new ways to understand and improve the associate experience. By listening to associates and combining their feedback with insights from their day-to-day work, we aim to identify what drives satisfaction, recognize emerging challenges, and help leaders take meaningful action.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the development of products that help Amazon understand how associates experience their work. You will shape our associate listening strategy, define how we measure satisfaction across key moments in the associate journey, and partner with science and engineering teams to translate feedback into actionable insights.  
This is an opportunity to build new capabilities from the ground up and influence how Amazon improves the experience of its global Customer Service workforce.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and execute the product roadmap for associate listening, satisfaction measurement, and insights capabilities.
* Develop the associate listening strategy, including survey design, question development, feedback collection, and measurement experiences.
* Partner with research and science teams to establish reliable measures of associate satisfaction, engagement, and wellbeing.
* Identify key moments in the associate journey and define how feedback and experience are measured across them.
* Combine associate feedback with operational and contextual data to identify drivers of satisfaction and emerging challenges.
* Partner with engineering and science teams to build scalable products that translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Define product success metrics and evaluate the impact of new capabilities on associate experience and business outcomes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
* Experience with survey research, employee listening platforms, Voice of Customer, or experience measurement products.
* Familiarity with survey design, sampling, response bias, and measurement validity.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. A **Business Development Manager (BDM)** at a filmmaking institute plays a pivotal role in driving revenue, building industry partnerships, expanding student enrollment, and positioning the institute as a premier destination for media education.

Because filmmaking is a deeply portfolio- and industry-driven field, the BDM bridges the gap between **education**, **student recruitment**, and **entertainment industry networks**.

Here is a comprehensive breakdown of the key roles and responsibilities of a Business Development Manager in a filmmaking institute:

**1. Student Enrollment & Revenue Growth**

* **Lead Generation & Pipeline Management:** Identify, target, and acquire prospective students for various filmmaking courses (Degree programs, Diplomas, Short-term Bootcamps, and Masterclasses).
* **Counseling & Conversion:** Oversee or collaborate with the admissions team to convert leads into enrollments through open days, campus tours, webinar presentations, and 1-on-1 counseling.
* **Corporate & Institutional Tie-ups:** Partner with high schools, colleges, and university arts departments to conduct workshops, talent hunts, and roadshows to build early-funnel awareness.
* **Pricing & Scholarship Strategy:** Analyze market demand to propose competitive pricing models, early-bird offers, or industry-sponsored scholarship programs.

**2. Industry Partnerships & Placements**

* **Production House Tie-Ups:** Build relationships with film production houses, OTT platforms (Netflix, Amazon Prime, Hotstar, etc.), ad agencies, and post-production studios to secure internships, apprenticeships, and job placements for students.
* **Guest Lectures & Masterclasses:** Network with established directors, cinematographers, screenwriters, editors, and actors to invite them as guest faculty or masterclass mentors.
* **Equipment & Tech Sponsorships:** Collaborate with camera, lighting, editing, and audio technology brands (e.g., RED, Arri, Blackmagic, Sony, Adobe, DaVinci Resolve) for hardware/software sponsorships, student discounts, and joint workshops.

**3. Brand Outreach, Events & Festivals**

* **Film Festival Collaborations:** Partner with local, national, and international film festivals to showcase student films, host panel discussions, or secure student accreditation/tickets.
* **Campus Events & Open Days:** Plan and execute flagship events such as Annual Student Film Screenings, Film Pitching Competitions, and Industry Mixer Nights.
* **Community Building:** Build relationships with local filmmaking communities, film clubs, and independent creators to keep the institute at the center of the regional film ecosystem.

**4. Product & Course Development Support**

* **Market Research & Trend Analysis:** Keep track of emerging industry trends (e.g., AI in filmmaking, Virtual Production/Unreal Engine, OTT content trends, drone cinematography) and advise the academic head to introduce relevant new courses or workshops.

* **International Alliances:** Explore student exchange programs, dual-degree pathways, or credit-transfer agreements with foreign film schools and universities.
* **Franchising / Multi-Center Expansion:** If applicable, identify new locations, franchise partners, or online learning platform opportunities to expand the institute’s footprint.

jobs.title: Process Improvement Specialist, EU FBA
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about making operations run smoother and more efficiently? Amazon is looking for a Process Improvement Specialist to join our EU FBA Support Operations team, where you will identify opportunities to enhance workflows, reduce waste, and drive meaningful results. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional partners to build and implement solutions that directly impact team performance and the associate experience.  
  
You will bring a data-informed mindset and a knack for problem-solving to tackle real operational challenges. Whether you are analyzing process metrics, creating new standard operating procedures, or coordinating with stakeholders to roll out improvements, your contributions will help us deliver for customers more effectively every day. If you are a curious, detail-oriented self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.  
  
A successful candidate must be able to work independently, thrive in ambiguous environments, effectively influence internal/external partners at all levels of the organization. This role will particularly suit someone with a strong innovative mindset, relationship building skills, operational excellence, superior project management capabilities, and strong people management experience.  
  
Some of the qualities that we are looking for: you are results-oriented (and have a track record of repeatedly delivering great results); you are an innovator (and have already proven it); you have the intellect and horsepower to solve really complex problems (some may say impossible to solve); you are an owner, and do what it takes to make your team successful; you have relentlessly high standards (some may say too high); you are customer obsessed; you operate well in an ambiguous environment; and finally, you have a burning desire to be a part of something really big.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Analyze operational data and process metrics to identify inefficiencies, points of failure, and improvement opportunities within fulfillment center workflows.
* Build and implement process improvement initiatives that enhance team outputs, including developing standard operating procedures and automating repetitive tasks where possible.
* Collaborate with peers, managers, and partner teams to troubleshoot operational issues, escalate risks, and align on solutions that balance time and resources.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to communicate project status, track progress, and drive alignment on improvement plans, ensuring clear and concise updates across all levels.
* Monitor system performance and service levels through defined metrics, using findings to refine processes and sustain long-term operational gains.
* Support development and implementation of Automation through data-driven analysis by coordinating with wider organization and tracking progress
* Identify and implement sustainable improvements for operational excellence using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* Execute strategic projects that deliver improvements in Seller Experience, productivity, and lowest cost-to-serve for Selling Partners and Amazon
* Collaborate with program stakeholders to clarify requirements and objectives. Support writing business and technical requirements documents
* Support establishment of business goals, metrics and key performance indicators (KPI) for success
* Build relationships with key stakeholders across global product, program and operational teams to support scalable solutions

  
A day in the life  
A typical day for an EU FBA Process Improvement Specialist will focus on executing Seller Experience initiatives and reduce Cost to Serve for Sellers and for Amazon, analyzing data to drive efficiency improvements, and collaborating with global teams to enhance seller services. They'll split their work between identifying process gaps, performing execution support, implementing process improvements using Lean/Six Sigma methods. Additionally, you might start your morning reviewing performance dashboards to spot trends or anomalies in s key metrics. jobs.description:
**Job Title: VP Client Relationship Servicing(CRS)**

CIB COO delivers strategic execution for the CIB businesses across the globe. Through transformative data and digital solutions, customer servicing throughout the customer lifecycle, and delivering safe growth supported by non-financial risk expertise, we collaborate across the global businesses and global functions to get it done.

Client Authorities & Confirmation Services (CACS) is part of the CIB CRS supporting CIB business by handling customer servicing requests across two journeys – Client Authorities and Audit Confirmation Services.

Beyond day-to-day operations leadership, the role holder is the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys - a critical, dual-mandate accountability that combines run-the-bank operations leadership with change-the-bank delivery ownership. This includes supporting the deployment of global technology solutions, working hand-in-hand with the Transformation function on requirements definition and testing, and directly shaping the future-state operating and technology architecture for CACS.

The role holder is equally accountable for the end-to-end client experience across CACS journeys: owning the process from first touch to completion, removing handoffs and delay between teams, and driving a continuous reduction in service SLAs/turnaround times - so clients experience a single, fast, joined-up service rather than a series of disconnected steps.

The role holder will oversee the general operations of the function including, but not limited to, financial planning/resource management, governance frameworks, digital implementation/adoption, performance management (OKRs, KPIs, SLAs), and stakeholder engagement, whilst additionally leading on ad-hoc initiatives as they arise to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of the function’s strategy and desired client outcomes.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own the end-to-end client experience for Audit Confirmations and Mandates/Authorities journeys, acting as the single point of accountability across the full process rather than for individual process steps. Redesign and simplify the CACS operating model to minimise handoffs and touchpoints between teams, reducing cycle time, rework and risk of error at each handover. Use client feedback, complaints and journey/turnaround-time analytics to identify friction points in the end-to-end process and prioritise fixes accordingly.
* Own and drive delivery of Client Authorities & Confirmation Services, objectives and key results (OKRs) aligned to CIB CRS priorities. Act as a primary point of contact and coordinator for relevant CIB Servicing Business Stakeholders and partner teams supporting CIB customers. Partner with business stakeholders to shape and agree the service proposition, including management information, service performance, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Act as the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys, owning the CACS-side accountability for translating business and client needs into deliverable, adopted technology outcomes.Drive the digital change agenda to improve customer experience, reduce operational effort across the end-to-end customer journey, and support and/or lead delivery of strategic tooling and automation initiatives (e.g., digital workflow and AI-enabled solutions) to enable the future-state servicing architecture and its adoption.
* Partner closely with the global Transformation function throughout the delivery lifecycle — defining and prioritising business requirements, validating solution design against operational reality, and sequencing releases against CACS servicing priorities.
* Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for CACS-impacting releases: design test scenarios, coordinate subject-matter-expert testers from the operations team, triage and track defects, and provide formal sign-off ahead of go-live.Track and report transformation milestones, risks, dependencies and benefits realisation to CIB CRS leadership, ensuring the CACS journey transformation stays aligned to global programme timelines.Champion change adoption within the CACS team — ensuring readiness, training, communication and embedding of new tools and ways of working through go-live and hypercare.
* Provide leadership across a diverse, multi-location and/or virtual team environment, driving performance to global standards in a matrix structure. Act as the primary representative for Client Authorities & Confirmation Services for the relevant value stream and stakeholders. Build a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, pace and accountability, ensuring teams understand priorities, processes and expected outcomes. Lead, coach, and develop a large team of specialists, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.

**To be successful you will:**

* Proven ability to run a large, multi-market teams across geographies and operating effectively across cultures and diverse working environments. Comfortable partnering with technology/ transformation teams to shape and adopt new tools – doesn’t need to run the transformation just needs to engage credibly and hold the CACS team accountable for adoption.
* Track record of client-centric decision-making prioritising client outcome over internal convenience. Demonstrable communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and drive alignment between operations, technology and client-facing audiences.
* Strong commercial mindset, including financial management capability and business acumen. Proven leadership and team management skills, with a focus on developing and motivating team members and experience in managing large, virtual teams. jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to lead the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?  
  
DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.  
  
We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of SDEs, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will own three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces (Scorecard, ORCAS, notifications); and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents embedded in the DSP Portal that provide actionable safety insights.  
  
This is a rare opportunity to build a team and platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead and grow a cross functional team of software engineers and data engineers to deliver across multiple strategic themes
* You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non tech audiences
* You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management
* Architect and deliver a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems into a single trusted source
* Own the design and delivery of a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed, replacing multiple fragmented config surfaces
* Drive development of compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
* Lead frontend and backend development of a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
* Partner with upstream platform teams to integrate sensing and signal fusion capabilities, positioning the team as the distribution and applied science layer
* Drive development of AI powered agents that make safety intelligence accessible to partners in plain language
* Define and track success metrics including signal to surface latency, configuration deployment time, incident context assembly time, and signal launch velocity
* Operate with two core principles: Zero Gravity (collapse dependencies into a single orchestrator) and Zero Friction (remove barriers between insight and action)

  
A day in the life  
You will lead a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve reviewing architectural designs for the governed data layer, partnering with upstream platform teams on signal integration, unblocking your engineers on the unified configuration layer, and reviewing predictive model outputs from your data scientists. You will regularly engage with stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, accountability, and legal teams to understand their pain points and translate those into platform capabilities. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands on technical leadership, ensuring your team delivers operationally stable, scalable solutions across multiple countries.  
  
About the team  
DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.  
  
We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of engineering experience
* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 3+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
* 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!
  
  
Who Are We?
  
  
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  
Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  
Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  
A Day in the Life of Senior Engineer - QA Automation (Tosca)!
  
  
We are seeking highly motivated, well-rounded, and fast-learning QA Automation Engineers to join our growing Quality Assurance (QA) team at ITH. In this role, you will be part of a dynamic environment where agility, rapid learning, and technical versatility are key.
  
  
The ideal candidates are not just specialized automation engineers, but complete QA professionals who understand the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC) and are ready to leverage modern technologies. **Project Role :** Business Process Architect  
**Project Role Description :** Analyze and design new business processes to create the documentation that guides the implementation of new processes and technologies. Partner with the business to define product requirements and use cases to meet process and functional requirements. Participate in user and task analysis to represent business needs.
  
**Must have skills :** SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
We are seeking a Senior Data Migration Consultant with deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA EAM/PM to lead end-to-end data migration for Maintenance Orders and Notifications, following the standard 9-phase migration model (Scoping, Data Profiling, Mapping, Extraction, Cleansing, Transformation, Load, Reconciliation, and Cutover/Sign-off). The consultant will own the migration strategy, object design, and execution for PM master and transactional data across mock/trial loads and production cutover.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  

* Lead data migration activities for PM/EAM objects — Equipment, Functional Location, Maintenance Plans, Task Lists, Orders, and Notifications — through all 9 migration phases.
* Define data mapping specifications (legacy-to-S/4HANA) and cleansing rules for Order and Notification data, including status history, partner objects, and long text.
* Design and validate migration objects using LTMC/LTMOM, LSMW, BAPIs/IDocs, BDC, or SAP Migration Cockpit (S/4HANA native tools).
* Own data extraction, transformation logic (ETL), and load sequencing, ensuring referential integrity between Orders, Notifications, Equipment, and Functional Locations.
* Drive mock load cycles (Mock 1, Mock 2, Mock 3) and reconciliation reports sign off on data quality metrics before cutover.
* Coordinate with Functional (PM/EAM), Basis, and ABAP teams to resolve object-level defects and data gaps.
* Prepare cutover run sheets, rollback plans, and hypercare support documentation for Order/Notification data objects.
* Liaise with business/process owners to validate migrated data against functional acceptance criteria.

  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  

* 10+ years in SAP data migration, with at least 3–4 full-cycle S/4HANA implementations.
* Strong hands-on expertise in SAP PM/EAM data objects (Orders, Notifications, Equipment, Functional Locations, Measuring Points, Task Lists).
* Proficiency in SAP Migration Cockpit, LTMC/LTMOM,APIs, LSMW, or BODS.
* Solid understanding of the 9-phase data migration methodology and governance (data quality gates, sign-offs, audit trails).
* Experience with data profiling/cleansing tools and reconciliation reporting.
* Working knowledge of ABAP debugging (for object enhancement) is a plus.
* Excellent stakeholder management and documentation skills.

  
  
Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 10+ years in SAP data migration, with at least 3–4 full-cycle S/4HANA implementations.
* This position is based at our Hyderabad office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

**Role Title: AVP - Enterprise Client Computing Product Owner (L11)**

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview:**
The AVP - Enterprise Client Computing Product Owner function is accountable for engineering, automating, and securing Synchrony’s end-user compute platforms across Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, and Virtual Desktop environments (e.g., Citrix / Horizon / AWS WorkSpaces / Cloud PC). The team drives modern endpoint management using Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and co-management (SCCM), with strong ownership of software packaging, patch orchestration, OS lifecycle management, endpoint configuration standards, and performance telemetry.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The AVP - Enterprise Client Computing Product Owner is accountable for the operational ownership, service reliability, security, compliance, financial stewardship, and continuous improvement of enterprise client computing services. This role leads endpoint run operations and product management across Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, VDI, AWS WorkSpaces, Cloud PCs, and related technologies. The Product Owner partners with engineering, infrastructure, information security, risk, service management, business stakeholders, and strategic vendors to deliver a secure, stable, high-performing, and user-focused employee computing experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end operational lifecycle management for desktops, laptops, Macs, Chromebooks, AWS WorkSpaces, VDI, Cloud PCs, and associated endpoint services.
* Manage service health, availability, capacity, performance, adoption, lifecycle outcomes, and achievement of agreed service levels.
* Lead incident triage, major incident response, service restoration, problem management, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Oversee patching, software distribution, configuration standards, endpoint hardening, vulnerability remediation, compliance reporting, encryption, certificates, and privileged access controls.
* Own the client computing product roadmap, backlog, priorities, key performance indicators, quarterly release plans, and modernization outcomes in partnership with engineering, security, and business stakeholders.
* Drive Intune-first and Autopilot-first management, co-management, automation, self-service, endpoint analytics, and production readiness while reducing legacy SCCM-only dependencies.
* Govern operational documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, support handoffs, business continuity, disaster recovery readiness, and annual resiliency activities.
* Support endpoint onboarding, provisioning, refresh, decommissioning, platform transitions, Windows 11 migration, and VDI or Cloud PC rationalization.
* Use telemetry and analytics, including endpoint and digital employee experience data, to improve reliability, performance, adoption, and user experience.
* Partner with Information Security and Risk to maintain audit readiness and provide evidence supporting applicable SOX, PCI, third-party risk, and change governance controls.
* Manage strategic vendor and managed service partner performance, staffing coverage, service levels, continuous improvement commitments, and monthly or quarterly service reviews.
* Own endpoint operating budgets, software licensing, and asset forecasts, identifying cost optimization opportunities across hardware, software, and managed services.
* Provide executive-level service reviews, roadmap updates, risk visibility, and timely communications to senior leaders and stakeholders.
* Collaborate across India and US time zones and participate in after-hours support, planned maintenance, and major service events when required.

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience in endpoint management, desktop operations, digital workplace technology, product ownership, infrastructure, or client computing services.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise-scale client computing services in a complex, global environment.
* Strong experience with Windows 10/11, macOS, ChromeOS, Citrix, AWS WorkSpaces, VDI, and Cloud PC technologies.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, SCCM/MECM co-management, Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD join, Endpoint Analytics, and Windows Update for Business.
* Working knowledge of endpoint technologies such as JAMF, Tanium, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Nexthink, Google Admin Console, Azure, AWS, PowerShell, ServiceNow, and Power Automate.

**Description**

* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives).

* Partner with developers, QA engineers, and project managers to ensure technical solutions meet business expectations.

jobs.description:
**About Niti Aide**

Niti Aide builds AI and digital solutions for government: dashboards for senior officers, citizen-facing WhatsApp and web assistants, and monitoring platforms for departments and public bodies. We are empanelled with NISG and work with bodies such as HMWSSB, GHMC, SERP and TGMSIDC across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. We’re a small, founder-led team, and the work you bring in is the work we build.

**The role**

This is not a desk BA job. You’ll spend 3–4 days a week inside government offices, meeting officers, understanding how departments actually run, and finding problems worth solving. Then you’ll work with our product and tech team to turn those problems into solutions, and follow through until the work order is signed.

You’ll own a set of departments end to end, from first meeting to signed work order, and you’ll be measured on it.

**What you’ll do**

* Visit government offices regularly and build working relationships with officers and their teams
* Run discovery conversations: how the department works, what data it has, which reviews it faces, and where it struggles
* Turn those conversations into clear one-page problem statements
* Co-design solutions with the founders and tech team
* Present concept notes, proposals and demos to officers
* Track tenders, RFPs, empanelments and nomination opportunities
* Follow up persistently on meetings, file movement and approvals until the work order comes through
* Maintain a clean pipeline of departments, stakeholders and next steps

**Who we’re looking for**

* MBA (2024–26 batch), or 1–3 years in B2B, institutional or field sales, or consulting
* Confident, well-presented and mature in conversation. You should be able to hold your own with senior officers, and we’ll coach you on the rest.
* A structured thinker who can turn a messy one-hour meeting into a crisp problem statement
* Fluent in Telugu, with strong spoken and written English
* Comfortable with Docs, Sheets and slides, and curious about AI. No coding needed.
* Willing to travel within Hyderabad and occasionally to districts and Amaravati. A two-wheeler or car is preferred.

**Strong advantages**

* Internship or work experience with a governance consulting firm, govtech company, PMU, or an industry body (CII, FICCI, NASSCOM)
* Any prior exposure to government departments or tenders

**This role is not for you if**

* You want a 10-to-6 desk job
* You’d rather document problems than chase them to a signed work order
* You’re uncomfortable following up five times to get one meeting

**What you get**

* ₹4–8 LPA, depending on experience and how you perform in the interview, plus conveyance and incentives on every work order you help bring in
* A clear path to Senior Business Analyst / Manager within 12–18 months, based on accounts you convert
* Direct work with the founders and real ownership from month one
* A first-hand view of how the state actually runs

**How to apply: walk in**

📅 Wednesday, 21 October (10 AM – 8 PM), or Thursday, 22 October and Friday, 23 October (9 AM – 12 PM)

📍 Niti Aide, 4th Floor, Mr Prime, Kondapur, Hyderabad

Come dressed the way you’d walk into a government office, and bring one idea:

*El Niño has hit this year. Which Telangana government department would you pitch a technology solution to, and what would you pitch?*

One page, your own thinking. That’s your first interview.

jobs.title: IT&D Senior Business Analyst, Demand Planning
jobs.description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Analyst, you will play a key role in enabling and improving Demand Planning capabilities by working at the intersection of business processes, data, and technology. You will lead analysis, solution design, and continuous improvement initiatives that help planners make better and faster decisions across the planning cycle.
  
  
You will partner with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external partners to drive process standardization, support strategic projects, and ensure planning solutions deliver measurable business value.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Act as a custodian of the global Demand Planning design template, ensuring alignment with established standards and reviewing solution designs developed by project teams.
* Support and lead specific workstreams within Demand Planning solution design, collaborating with architects and senior stakeholders to define scalable solutions.
* Analyze business requirements and partner with process owners to translate functional needs into effective technical solutions.
* Facilitate design discussions, workshops, and requirement clarification sessions with business and technical teams.
* Present workstream updates, design recommendations, risks, and decisions to project stakeholders and technical teams.
* Contribute to the creation, review, and governance of training materials, solution documentation, and change requests.
* Support future-state process and solution design activities, including governance frameworks, KPIs, reporting structures, and operating models.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 4–8 years of overall experience in Supply Chain Planning and Digital Transformation.
* Minimum 2 years of Kinaxis RapidResponse authoring/configuration experience.
* Strong understanding of Demand Planning, Forecasting, Demand Sensing, and S&OP processes.
* Kinaxis Author Level 1/Level 2 or equivalent certification preferred.
* Experience participating in at least one end-to-end Kinaxis implementation.
* Hands-on experience with Workbooks, Dashboards, Worksheets, Alerts, Automation Chains, Forms, and Data Modeling.
* Experience in business requirement gathering, functional design, testing, and deployment activities.
* Understanding of Agile/SAFe methodologies and product delivery practices.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.

The skills for success
  
  
Kinaxis Rapid Response, Demand Planning, Supply Chain Planning
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

Global SCM Manager

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa’s Risk and Identity Solutions (RaIS) group delivers advanced fraud detection and prevention solutions, ensuring seamless, secure payment experiences. The Predictive Fraud Intelligence (PFI) team develops core AI/ML products within the Visa Protect suite, empowering clients to detect and prevent fraud throughout the payment lifecycle.

As fraud vectors have rapidly evolved, PFI has significantly expanded its product portfolio and reimagined its approach to building, deploying, and monitoring real-time, low-latency AI models. We seek a seasoned AI product Manager to drive platform capabilities and tooling, accelerating model development and supporting diverse client needs.

Visa is seeking a seasoned Product Manager with a keen interest in heavy tech platforms, deep understanding of ML development lifecycle & MLOps, and a strong passion for innovation. As a product leader, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Data Science, Cross-functional Product, and Regional teams to define priorities, craft solutions, and deliver key product capabilities.

jobs.title: Manager - Branding
jobs.description:
**About the Team**

The Commerce Platform team at Meesho drives end-to-end growth, strategy, and operational excellence across key verticals:

* **User Growth:** Scales the full lifecycle funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention. The User Growth team also houses Meesho’s branding pods, which shape how Bharat sees, trusts and keeps coming back to Meesho.
* **Marketplace:** Focuses on strengthening the seller ecosystem and improving selection quality to create a robust and reliable marketplace experience.
* **Category:** Identifies high-potential segments, launches and scales new categories, and drives assortment expansion to meet evolving customer demand.
* **Mall:** Builds a trusted branded destination for quality-conscious users, enhancing the platform’s premium and branded shopping experience.
* **Pricing:** Ensures competitiveness and affordability, enabling the platform to deliver strong value for customers while maintaining marketplace health.
* **Content Commerce:** Powers content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven shopping journeys that drive engagement, trust, and conversion.

Together, these verticals identify whitespace opportunities, launch and scale new initiatives, and continuously optimize the user lifecycle through data-backed decisions. Operating in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment, the team combines structured problem-solving with rapid execution to deliver meaningful impact.

If you’re excited about building a brand that millions across Bharat love and return to, this role offers both strategic depth and hands-on impact.

**About the Role**

As a Manager – Programs (Branding), you will anchor the branding pods within User Growth. You will own Meesho’s brand strategy end to end: understanding what holds users back and what brings them back, turning those insights into sharp brand briefs, and leading the campaigns that land them across TV, digital and influencers.

This is a hands-on role for a brand builder, not a documentation role. You will spend time with users first-hand, shape communication for India’s many consumer cohorts, and lead a team that delivers large, high-impact campaigns that move user growth and retention.

### **What you will do**

* **Consumer Understanding:** Interact with users to understand the barriers that stop them from using Meesho and the triggers that bring them back, and synthesize these first-hand insights into clear, actionable direction.
* **Brand Strategy & Briefs:** Develop Meesho’s brand strategy and write brand briefs that translate consumer insight into a sharp proposition for creative and media partners.
* **Communication Strategy:** Define the communication strategy and channel mix across TV and mass media, digital, and influencers.
* **Cohort-Led Messaging:** Tailor communication and messaging for distinct user cohorts (South/North, urban/rural, female/male, etc.) so the brand resonates across Bharat.
* **Campaign Ownership:** Own large-scale campaigns end to end, from brief to launch to measurement, and track their impact on brand and business metrics.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate with Product, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Legal, and external creative, media and influencer agencies to deliver campaigns and secure buy-in from senior leadership.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead and develop the branding pod, set priorities, raise the creative and strategic bar, and remove roadblocks to execution.

### **What you will need**

* **Education:** MBA from a top-tier institute (IIM, ISB or similar) with a subsequent move into branding, or a specialist branding background (e.g., MICA). Other strong MBA or brand profiles are welcome.
* **Experience:** 4+ years of hands-on experience in brand management or consumer marketing, preferably in FMCG or e-commerce.
* **Hands-on Branding:** Prior, direct branding experience is essential, including building brand strategy and briefs yourself.
* **First-hand Consumer Understanding:** Demonstrated experience of personally interacting with consumers, synthesizing insights, and translating them into a brand brief or campaign.
* **Campaign Ownership:** Direct ownership of significant campaigns across TV, digital and/or influencers, with at least one major career highlight and measurable impact.
* **Communication:** Excellent storytelling, negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to generate buy-in from senior stakeholders and external partners.
* **Leadership:** Team management experience and the ability to advocate for user-driven decisions while thinking critically and executing tactically.

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

jobs.title: Branch Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.
* Execute local marketing activities and maintain relationships with local business communities to generate leads.
* Oversee loan renewal mix and repeat customer retention strategies.
* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.
* **Growth:** Total Assets Under Management (AUM) and monthly disbursement volume.
* **Risk & Portfolio:** Non-Performing Assets (NPA) percentage and audit compliance score.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–8 years in banking/NBFC operations, with proven experience in branch management, team hiring, and gold loan processing.
* **Technical Skills:** Interviewing techniques, knowledge of gold appraisal methods, basic accounting, and branch management software.
* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to own the vision, strategy and execution of the roadmap for SmartSense CRE, Ecolibrium's commercial real estate product line within the broader SmartSense platform. The role will work closely with Engineering, Design, Field Operations, Sales and Delivery to turn market insight and customer feedback into products that are competitive, high-quality and aligned to Ecolibrium's business goals.

The Senior Product Manager will lead market research, define product strategy, guide development from concept to launch and track performance against clear KPIs. SmartSense is a technically layered product spanning real-time IoT telemetry, deterministic rules engines, machine learning models and, in select modules, conversational AI. This role requires strong strategic thinking, genuine technical fluency across these layers, stakeholder management and the ability to inspire and align teams around a shared product vision. Requires 7+ years of relevant experience.

**THE WORK**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement product vision, strategy and roadmap for SmartSense CRE, in alignment with Ecolibrium's business goals.
* Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis, including in AI-enabled energy and building management tooling, to identify trends, opportunities and customer needs.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design and other teams to guide product development from concept through to launch, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
* Define product requirements for AI-driven features (ML forecasting models, conversational AI modules) with the same rigour as deterministic features, including clear scoping of what the AI is and is not responsible for.
* Engage internal and external stakeholders, including customers, to gather feedback, understand requirements and ensure product success.
* Define and monitor key product performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and inform product decisions.
* Drive continuous product improvement through customer feedback, data analysis and industry best practices.
* Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with cross-functional teams to achieve product goals.
* Translate market insights and customer needs into actionable product requirements and prioritised backlogs.
* Partner with Sales and Presales to support go-to-market activities, positioning and customer-facing product narratives, ensuring AI capabilities are represented accurately and never overstated.
* Lead and motivate cross-functional teams, setting a compelling product vision that inspires others to deliver against it.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
* 7+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of leading successful product initiatives.
* Experience in IoT, building management systems or related industries is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of product development processes, market research techniques and data analysis tools.
* Working fluency with AI product concepts: able to distinguish deterministic rule-based logic from machine learning and from LLM-based conversational features, and to make sound product decisions about where each is appropriate.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Ability to think strategically and translate market insights into actionable product strategies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical and AI-related concepts to diverse, including non-technical, stakeholders.
* Strong customer orientation with a passion for creating products that deliver exceptional value and user experience.

**Desirable**

* Experience as a visionary, analytical and collaborative product leader who thrives on solving complex problems.
* Exposure to energy management, industrial IoT or connected-building product categories.
* Direct experience shipping AI or ML-powered features, including forecasting models, anomaly detection or conversational/LLM-based assistants, and communicating their capabilities and limits honestly to clients.
* Familiarity with agile product development and data-driven experimentation.
* Awareness of responsible AI practices relevant to enterprise B2B products, such as per-tenant data isolation, model risk considerations and honest disclosure of AI capability and certification status.

jobs.description:
**We Are Hiring | Product Manager, Enterprise AI Platform | Bengaluru**

**About ReN3**

ReN3 is a sovereign AI platform for the enterprise, built to unify an organization's knowledge and let teams execute AI-powered work under strict governance and access control. The platform runs in air-gapped, private-cloud, or other sovereign environments, so sensitive data never leaves the client's own infrastructure. ReN3 works with government, banking and financial services, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, and construction clients, and partners with major infrastructure and cloud providers on deployment.

**About the Role**

As a Product Manager, you will own a product area from start to finish: the customer problem, the spec, the build, the eval, the release and adoption. You will work directly with engineers, the field team and customers. You create your own path, even when there’s no roadmap to follow, and stand confidently by the choices you make.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own one or two product areas.**
  Examples: agents and workflows, knowledge ingestion and search, or admin and governance.
* **Turn customer reality into decisions.**
  Join customer calls, read RFPs and field requests, and decide what to build, what to defer and what to refuse.
* **Write specs that ship.**
  Your specs cover acceptance criteria, edge cases, permission rules, empty states and failure states. They should be clear enough for a coding agent to build from and for an engineer to review against.
* **Build things yourself.**
  Use coding agents to make prototypes, internal tools, scripts and small product fixes. Opening a PR for a copy change or a UI tweak is part of the job.
* **Define quality for AI features.**
  Build eval sets and golden prompts. Measure answer quality, latency and cost. Make ship or no-ship calls from data, not from a good demo.
* **Run releases.**
  Prioritise, cut scope, write release notes, and equip the field team to sell, deploy and support what shipped.
* **Measure adoption.**
  Know which features customers use, which they don't and why.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must-have**

* Based in Bengaluru
* **3–5 years in product management**
  , at least 2 of them on B2B SaaS, developer or platform products. Engineers and founders who moved into product are welcome.
* **Daily use of agentic coding.**
  You have shipped something real, mostly built with coding agents: a prototype, an internal tool or a side project. You can show it and explain where the agent went wrong.
* **A working understanding of LLM products:**
  retrieval (RAG), tool calling, context limits, hallucination and evals. You know why a demo that works 8 times out of 10 is not yet a product.
* **High agency**
  . Take initiative, solve problems, deliver results, adapt quickly, and own your outcomes.
* **Clear writing.**
  Short specs, crisp decisions, no filler.
* **Comfortable with enterprise requirements:**
  SSO, roles and permissions, audit logs, data residency and security questionnaires.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience using evaluation tooling such as promptfoo, Braintrust or LangSmith.
* Experience with enterprise sales cycles, RFPs or tenders.
* Products shipped into banking, government or other regulated industries.

**How to apply**

* Submit your resume (more specifications below).
* Ensure your resume includes a link to something you built mostly with coding agents (a repo, a live URL or a 3-minute Loom).
* Ensure your resume includes a short paragraph on one thing the agent got wrong and how you caught it.

At Moving Tech, Product Managers own the product journey end-to-end, balancing product development, operations, and customer engagement. This is an opportunity to be a true creator, not just a coordinator.

**Can PMs become TRUE creators?**

* Can they CODE?

As a Sr. Product Manager - High Confidence Supply-chain at Amazon, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for products that bring determinism in our fulfillment experience, and consequently, shape our concession and returns reduction strategy.
